purpose: Replace the type-only name for the actor Type-0A terminal-interaction path.

contract.source: Clears the colliding source actor and releases its owned resources
contract.receiver: Runs Actor_HandleType2DInteraction on the receiving actor
contract.terminal: Enters Actor_ApplyTerminalCollisionResponse, which clears/reinitializes the receiving record from the Type-0x84 terminal template
contract.countdown: The shared terminal response can arm SCENE_SCRIPT_COUNTDOWN=0x20 for receiving types 0x10, 0x11, and 0x13

evidence: Direct calls to Actor_ClearOwnedResources, Actor_HandleType2DInteraction, and Actor_ApplyTerminalCollisionResponse
Actor Type-0x03 entry falls through to this common terminal path
conclusion: The former Type-0A-only label understated a terminal interaction path shared by the Type-0x03 fall-through; the legacy name remains an alias.
